# SPOS Effects — full reference

> Complete, expanded reference of the SPOS Effects library for LLMs and AI agents. Includes every effect with its demo HTML and the full compiled CSS (30 effects, pure CSS, MIT).

- Website: https://spos-systems.github.io/SPOS-Effects
- Repository: https://github.com/spos-systems/SPOS-Effects
- Catalog: https://spos-systems.github.io/SPOS-Effects/effects.json
- One-file CSS: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/spos-systems/SPOS-Effects@v1.0.1/spos-effects.css

## Effect reference (HTML snippets)

### Slide Fill (`btn-slide-fill`)

A solid layer slides in from the left on hover while the label smoothly changes color, using a ::before pseudo-element and transform transitions.

HTML:

```html
<button class="fx-btn-slide-fill">Hover Me</button>
```

### Neon Glow (`btn-neon-glow`)

A cyberpunk-style neon button. Text-shadow and layered box-shadows bloom into a bright blue halo on hover.

HTML:

```html
<button class="fx-btn-neon-glow">Power On</button>
```

### 3D Push (`btn-3d-push`)

A chunky retro arcade button with a hard shadow base. Pressing it (active state) sinks the button into its shadow for a physical 3D feel.

HTML:

```html
<button class="fx-btn-3d-push">Press Me</button>
```

### Border Runner (`btn-border-runner`)

A comet of gradient light endlessly orbits the button border, built with a rotating conic-gradient pseudo-element clipped by overflow: hidden.

HTML:

```html
<button class="fx-btn-border-runner">Loading...</button>
```

### Arrow Swap (`btn-arrow-swap`)

On hover the arrow icon slides out and a second one slides in from the right, while the button fills with color — a classic modern CTA micro-interaction.

HTML:

```html
<button class="fx-btn-arrow-swap">
  <span class="fx-btn-arrow-swap-label">Explore</span>
  <span class="fx-btn-arrow-swap-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>
</button>
```

### Ripple Press (`btn-ripple`)

Material-style ripple that radiates from the center on every press, animated with the :active pseudo-class — no JavaScript required.

HTML:

```html
<button class="fx-btn-ripple">Click Me</button>
```

### Gradient Flow (`text-gradient-flow`)

An animated multi-color gradient that flows endlessly through the letters, made with background-clip: text and a looping background-position animation.

HTML:

```html
<h3 class="fx-text-gradient-flow">Gradient Flow</h3>
```

### Typewriter (`text-typewriter`)

Types and deletes text in a loop using the steps() timing function on the width property, complete with a blinking caret on the border-right.

HTML:

```html
<h3 class="fx-text-typewriter">Pure CSS effects...</h3>
```

### Highlight Sweep (`text-highlight-sweep`)

A highlighter marker sweeps across the text on hover by animating background-size from 0% to 100% — perfect for headings that reveal emphasis.

HTML:

```html
<h3 class="fx-text-highlight-sweep">Highlight me</h3>
```

### Glitch (`text-glitch`)

Cyberpunk distortion: two colored copies of the text (via data-text attribute and pseudo-elements) jitter with randomized clip-path slices.

HTML:

```html
<h3 class="fx-text-glitch" data-text="GLITCH">GLITCH</h3>
```

### Wave Letters (`text-wave-letters`)

Each letter rides a gentle wave with a staggered animation-delay, creating a rippling motion — no JavaScript, just per-letter spans.

HTML:

```html
<h3 class="fx-text-wave-letters">
  <span>W</span><span>A</span><span>V</span><span>E</span><span>&nbsp;</span><span>W</span><span>O</span><span>R</span><span>L</span><span>D</span>
</h3>
```

### Dual Ring (`loader-dual-ring`)

Two counter-rotating rings built with asymmetric border colors and opposite spin animations — a timeless spinner for any waiting state.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-loader-dual-ring" role="status" aria-label="Loading"></div>
```

### Bouncing Dots (`loader-bouncing-dots`)

Three playful dots bounce in sequence with staggered animation delays and a soft opacity breathing effect.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-loader-bouncing-dots" role="status" aria-label="Loading">
  <span></span><span></span><span></span>
</div>
```

### Pulse Ring (`loader-pulse-ring`)

Radar-style expanding rings emitted from a solid core. Two pseudo-elements share one keyframe with a one-second offset for a continuous sonar pulse.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-loader-pulse-ring" role="status" aria-label="Loading"></div>
```

### Stripe Progress Bar (`loader-stripe-bar`)

An indeterminate progress bar: a striped block slides left-to-right with repeating-linear-gradient stripes scrolling inside it.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-loader-stripe-bar" role="status" aria-label="Loading">
  <div class="fx-loader-stripe-bar-track"></div>
</div>
```

### Orbit (`loader-orbit`)

A glowing moon circles a planet along a rotating dashed orbit — pure CSS astronomy using nested pseudo-elements.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-loader-orbit" role="status" aria-label="Loading"></div>
```

### Hover Lift (`card-hover-lift`)

The card floats up with a soft blue glow on hover. A spring-like cubic-bezier easing makes the motion feel physical.

HTML:

```html
<article class="fx-card-hover-lift">
  <h4>Hover Lift</h4>
  <p>Float above the noise with a spring-eased elevation and a glowing blue aura.</p>
  <span class="fx-card-hover-lift-link">Learn more &rarr;</span>
</article>
```

### 3D Flip (`card-flip-3d`)

A true 3D card flip on hover: preserve-3d keeps both faces in shared perspective while backface-visibility hides the far side.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-card-flip-3d">
  <div class="fx-card-flip-3d-inner">
    <div class="fx-card-flip-3d-face fx-card-flip-3d-front">
      <strong>Hover to flip</strong>
      <small>Front side</small>
    </div>
    <div class="fx-card-flip-3d-face fx-card-flip-3d-back">
      <strong>Back side</strong>
      <small>See you on the flip side</small>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

### Spotlight (`card-spotlight`)

Hovering reveals a radial spotlight that washes over the card. Tip: drive the position with a --fx-x/--fx-y custom property and two lines of JS to make it follow the cursor.

HTML:

```html
<article class="fx-card-spotlight">
  <h4>Spotlight</h4>
  <p>A soft blue light blooms from the center of the card on hover.</p>
</article>
```

### Image Zoom Reveal (`card-image-zoom`)

A cover image (here a pure-CSS sunset gradient) zooms gently while a caption slides up with a gradient scrim — a classic media card pattern.

HTML:

```html
<figure class="fx-card-image-zoom">
  <div class="fx-card-image-zoom-img"></div>
  <figcaption class="fx-card-image-zoom-caption">
    <strong>Golden Hour</strong>
    <span>Sunset over the bay</span>
  </figcaption>
</figure>
```

### Animated Gradient Border (`card-gradient-border`)

A rotating conic-gradient ring glows around the card forever. The ring is an oversized pseudo-element clipped by overflow: hidden.

HTML:

```html
<article class="fx-card-gradient-border">
  <h4>Gradient Border</h4>
  <p>An aurora ring endlessly circles this card. Zero JavaScript, one pseudo-element.</p>
</article>
```

### Shifting Gradient (`bg-gradient-shift`)

A deep blue gradient that slowly drifts across an oversized background — calm, ambient, and perfect for hero sections.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-bg-gradient-shift"></div>
```

### Futuristic Grid (`bg-futuristic-grid`)

A synthwave grid built from two repeating gradients, softly faded at the edges with a radial mask — instantly sets a tech mood.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-bg-futuristic-grid"></div>
```

### Drifting Dot Matrix (`bg-dot-matrix`)

A dot-pattern background that gently drifts forever. Made with a single radial-gradient tile and an animated background-position.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-bg-dot-matrix"></div>
```

### Moving Diagonal Stripes (`bg-diagonal-stripes`)

Amber diagonal candy stripes that scroll seamlessly. The background-position period (67.88px) matches the 45deg stripe wavelength exactly.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-bg-diagonal-stripes"></div>
```

### Aurora (`bg-aurora`)

Two blurred orbs of light float and morph like the northern lights — layered pseudo-elements with filter: blur and slow transforms.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-bg-aurora"></div>
```

### Underline Grow (`input-underline-grow`)

Focus the field and a two-tone gradient underline grows outward from the center — powered by :focus-within and a transform-happy pseudo-element.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-input-underline-grow">
  <input type="text" placeholder="Focus me..." />
</div>
```

### Floating Label (`input-floating-label`)

The label shrinks and floats to the top when the field is focused or filled. The trick: :not(:placeholder-shown) needs an empty placeholder to detect content.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-input-floating-label">
  <input type="email" id="fx-float-demo" placeholder=" " />
  <label for="fx-float-demo">Email address</label>
</div>
```

### Glow Focus (`input-glow-focus`)

On focus the field lifts slightly and lights up with a layered amber glow — a friendly, tactile way to show where the user is typing.

HTML:

```html
<input class="fx-input-glow-focus" type="text" placeholder="Start typing..." />
```

### Expanding Search (`input-search-expand`)

A circular icon that blooms into a full search field on focus. The wrapper animates its width while the magnifier glides to the right edge.

HTML:

```html
<div class="fx-input-search-expand">
  <input type="text" placeholder="Search effects..." aria-label="Search" />
  <span class="fx-input-search-expand-icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round">
      <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"></circle>
      <path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"></path>
    </svg>
  </span>
</div>
```


## Full compiled CSS (spos-effects.css)

```css
.fx-btn-slide-fill {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 0;
  padding: 0.875rem 2.25rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #2563eb;
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px solid #2563eb;
  border-radius: 0.55rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: color 0.35s ease;
}

.fx-btn-slide-fill::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  background: #2563eb;
  transform: translateX(-101%);
  transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.fx-btn-slide-fill:hover {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.fx-btn-slide-fill:hover::before {
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.fx-btn-neon-glow {
  padding: 0.875rem 2.25rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #60a5fa;
  background: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.06);
  border: 2px solid #60a5fa;
  border-radius: 0.55rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.6);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 14px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.12),
    0 0 12px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.18);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.fx-btn-neon-glow:hover {
  color: #0b1220;
  background: #60a5fa;
  text-shadow: none;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 22px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.85),
    0 0 64px rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.45);
}

.fx-btn-3d-push {
  padding: 0.9rem 2.25rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: #fff1f2;
  background: #f43f5e;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0.65rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  transform: translateY(0);
  box-shadow:
    0 6px 0 #9f1239,
    0 12px 18px rgba(159, 18, 57, 0.35);
  transition: transform 0.1s ease, box-shadow 0.1s ease, background 0.2s ease;
}

.fx-btn-3d-push:hover {
  background: #fb7185;
}

.fx-btn-3d-push:active {
  transform: translateY(6px);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 #9f1239,
    0 3px 8px rgba(159, 18, 57, 0.25);
}

.fx-btn-border-runner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 0;
  padding: 0.875rem 2.25rem;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: #fbbf24;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0.6rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.fx-btn-border-runner::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  z-index: -2;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 200%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg);
  background: conic-gradient(
    transparent 0deg,
    #fbbf24 40deg,
    #f59e0b 80deg,
    transparent 120deg,
    transparent 360deg
  );
  animation: fx-border-runner-spin 2.4s linear infinite;
}

.fx-btn-border-runner::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 2px;
  z-index: -1;
  border-radius: calc(0.6rem - 2px);
  background: #1c1917;
  transition: background 0.3s ease;
}

.fx-btn-border-runner:hover {
  color: #78350f;
}

.fx-btn-border-runner:hover::after {
  background: #fbbf24;
}

@keyframes fx-border-runner-spin {
  to {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg);
  }
}

.fx-btn-arrow-swap {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 0;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  padding: 0.875rem 1.9rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #2563eb;
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px solid #2563eb;
  border-radius: 999px;
  cursor: pointer;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: color 0.35s ease;
}

  content: "";
  position: absolute;

}

  color: #ffffff;
}

  transform: translateX(0);
}

  position: relative;
  width: 1.15em;
  height: 1.15em;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.fx-btn-arrow-swap-icon::before,
.fx-btn-arrow-swap-icon::after {
  content: "\2192";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-size: 1.05em;
  line-height: 1;
  transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.fx-btn-arrow-swap-icon::after {
  transform: translateX(110%);
}

.fx-btn-arrow-swap:hover .fx-btn-arrow-swap-icon::before {
  transform: translateX(-110%);
}

.fx-btn-arrow-swap:hover .fx-btn-arrow-swap-icon::after {
  transform: translateX(0);
}

.fx-btn-ripple {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0.9rem 2.4rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #ffffff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8b5cf6, #d946ef);
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0.6rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.35);
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
}

.fx-btn-ripple:active {
  transform: scale(0.95);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3);
}

.fx-btn-ripple::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 130%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0);
  opacity: 0;
}

.fx-btn-ripple:active::after {
  animation: fx-btn-ripple 0.65s ease-out;
}

@keyframes fx-btn-ripple {
  from {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0);
    opacity: 0.6;
  }
  to {
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1);
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

.fx-text-gradient-flow {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 2.6rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #fbbf24, #f472b6, #a78bfa, #3b82f6);
  background-size: 300% 100%;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  color: transparent;
  animation: fx-text-gradient-flow 6s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes fx-text-gradient-flow {
  to {
    background-position: 300% 0;
  }
}

  margin: 0;

    width: 0;

  }
}

  }

    border-right-color: transparent;
  }
}

.fx-text-highlight-sweep {
  margin: 0;

}

    transform: translateY(-0.45em);
  }
}

.fx-loader-pulse-ring {
  position: relative;
  width: 20px;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
```

## Usage

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/spos-systems/SPOS-Effects@v1.0.1/spos-effects.css" />
<button class="fx-btn-slide-fill">Hover Me</button>
```
